headline: AVY Q2 Deep Dive: Inventory Dynamics and Intelligent Labels Propel Growth
summary: Adhesive manufacturing company Avery Dennison (NYSE:AVY) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.9% year on year to $2.46 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.89 per share was 17% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Avery Dennison (AVY) Is Up 12.6% After EPS Beat And Higher 2026 Guidance Has The Bull Case Changed?
summary: Avery Dennison’s recent quarter delivered revenue of US$2.46 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share of US$2.89, both ahead of analyst expectations, while management issued full-year 2026 EPS guidance of US$9.40 to US$9.70. The company also continued returning cash to shareholders, completing US$482.59 million of buybacks since April 2025 and affirming a quarterly dividend of US$1.00 per share payable in September 2026. We’ll now examine how this earnings beat and higher full-year EPS...
